commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: The unlearned can be seen, so some will say they exist, and no more. They are like salt land that grows nothing, of no use to themselves or to others. Such land is neglected and gives no creature food, and they are given no regard and give no one knowledge.
